speaker: Doctor
text: I notice you mentioned fatigue, abdominal pain, night sweats, weight loss, and enlarged supraclavicular lymph nodes. To better understand your condition, have you experienced any recent fevers, skin rashes, or changes in your bowel habits? Also, do you have a history of recent infections or travel?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling very tired and have had worsening abdominal pain for about four weeks. I have also had drenching night sweats and lost about twelve pounds.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the details. To narrow down the cause of your systemic symptoms and lymphadenopathy, have you noticed any specific changes in your urine color or stool consistency, such as dark urine or clay-colored stools? Also, do you have a history of blood disorders like sickle cell anemia or G6PD deficiency?

speaker: Patient
text: I noticed swelling in my neck over the last few days. It does not hurt, but it feels enlarged and fixed.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Hodgkin Lymphoma. The combination of drenching night sweats, significant weight loss, fatigue, and a fixed, painless supraclavicular lymph node is highly suspicious for this malignancy. I will proceed to order imaging and biopsy results to confirm the diagnosis.
